Mehli Mistry Resigns from Ratan Tata's Family Office

Mehli Mistry has resigned from the board of RNT Associates, Ratan Tata's family investment office. This move follows his earlier ousting from Tata Trusts and signifies a further separation from the Tata Group. Mistry is currently contesting his removal from the Trusts before the Maharashtra charity commissioner.
